answer: A concrete defense is progressive bond escalation: each new identity must post a stake that grows with the number of identities already seen from the same hardware or wallet cluster, and that stake is slashed the moment a cluster is confirmed fake. Attackers who wander in from fresh addresses hit a steep ledge of rising cost they cannot cross cheaply, while honest newcomers rest in an oasis of low, one-time friction. Sybil volume stops paying for itself.
